purpose: Verified candidate venues for the Zanzibar owner field-test pack. Input only; not a catalog.
source: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API (name, coordinates, refs, opening_hours); Wikidata for ids. Data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0.
licence_note: Owner-only hand curation under the SPEC-21 exception. Do not bulk-ingest or redistribute; SPEC-21 ODbL review is a remainder before any wider use.
rules: Coordinates (lat, lng) and osm_ref/wikidata come from OSM and must not be edited. name is a planner-cleaned display name; osm_name is the raw OSM value.

opening_hours_osm is unverified. Convert ONLY strings that are exactly 'Mo-Su HH:MM-HH:MM' or 'Mo-Sa HH:MM-HH:MM' (one range, no semicolons, no 24:00, no PH) to the structured form; set opening_hours null for every other venue.
No dishes, prices, wheelchair notes or hours may be added that are not in this file or in the 'note' field.
bucket values: culture, food, rest, nature. category_suggestion must be a VALID_CATEGORIES member.

venues.name: House of Wonders
venues.note: Beit al-Ajaib; large waterfront palace-turned-museum on Forodhani. Verify whether interior is open to visitors on the day.

venues.name: Palace Museum (Sultan's Palace)
venues.note: Former sultan's palace on the waterfront, museum of the Zanzibar sultanate.

venues.name: Old Slave Market and Slavery Memorial
venues.note: Site of the former slave market and memorial; sober, guided visits are common. Wikidata Q7084983 on the OSM object was rejected: resolves to the Old Slave Mart in Charleston, South Carolina, not Zanzibar.

venues.name: Hamamni Persian Baths
venues.note: Historic 19th-century bathhouse in Stone Town.

venues.name: Peace Memorial Museum (Beit el Amani)
venues.note: Museum on Creek Road; OSM also carries a duplicate node n1962447837 for the same place.

venues.name: Princess Salme Museum
venues.note: Museum in Stone Town about Sayyida Salme / Emily Ruete.

venues.name: Freddie Mercury Museum (Mercury House)
venues.note: OSM also has memorial node n7108530286 and nearby restaurant w356211667 is separate (Mercury's).

venues.name: Tippu Tip's House
venues.note: Historic merchant house; treat as exterior/landmark stop unless owner confirms entry.

venues.name: Old Fort (Ngome Kongwe)
venues.note: Old Fort next to Forodhani; courtyard with shops and amphitheatre.

venues.name: Old Dispensary
venues.note: Restored waterfront building; short architecture stop.

venues.name: Maruhubi Palace Ruins
venues.note: Ruins of 19th-century palace north of Stone Town (about 4 to 5 km).

venues.name: Mtoni Palace Ruins
venues.note: Ruins of Mtoni Palace on the coast north of Stone Town (about 6 to 7 km).

venues.name: Lukmaan Restaurant
venues.note: Local Zanzibari restaurant; skip the dish list unless verified on site.

venues.name: Mercury's Restaurant
venues.note: Waterfront restaurant and bar near Forodhani.

venues.name: Forodhani Night Food Market
venues.note: Evening street food market in Forodhani Gardens. Evening only; hours unverified.

venues.name: Malindi Fish Market
venues.note: Fish market near the old port, mornings most active. Name from OSM is 'Fish Market'; 'Malindi' is a locality label added by the planner.

venues.name: Passing Show
venues.note: Restaurant in the Malindi area.

venues.name: Livingstone's Beach Restaurant
venues.note: Beachfront restaurant and bar on the Stone Town shore. OSM name is 'Livingstone's'.

venues.name: Beach House Restaurant and Bar
venues.note: Waterfront restaurant and bar.

venues.name: Zanzibar Coffee House
venues.note: OSM name is 'Zanzibar Coffee House;Delicious soups'; use the clean name.

venues.name: Karafuu Coffee House
venues.note: OSM name is KARAFUU COFFEE HOUSE.

venues.name: Lazuli
venues.note: Cafe near the waterfront; OSM tags it as a restaurant.

venues.name: Archipelago Cafe and Restaurant
venues.note: Waterfront cafe and restaurant.

venues.name: Urojo at Jitini
venues.note: Urojo is a Zanzibari street soup; venue is Urojo @ Jitini in OSM.

venues.name: Radha Vegetarian Restaurant
venues.note: Vegetarian-only restaurant; useful for a non-meat option.

venues.name: Stone Town Cafe
venues.note: Cafe with long OSM hours.

venues.name: Zenji Garden Cafe
venues.note: Garden cafe near Forodhani; OSM has a duplicate way w1578185693.

venues.name: Tangawizi Bistro
venues.note: Quiet bistro; no spa/massage venue in Stone Town was verifiable in OSM.

venues.name: Cafe Miwa
venues.note: Cafe with listed daily hours.

venues.name: Puzzle Coffee Shop
venues.note: Coffee shop, closed Sundays per OSM.

venues.name: Forodhani Gardens
venues.note: Waterfront park; hosts the night food market.

venues.name: Jamhuri Gardens
venues.note: Public gardens near the Karume Monument.

venues.name: Victoria Gardens
venues.note: Public gardens in the south of Stone Town.

venues.name: Forodhani Sunset Place
venues.note: Sunset viewing spot on the Forodhani seafront (OSM name 'Sunset place').

venues.name: Changuu (Prison Island) Tortoise Sanctuary
venues.note: Boat from Stone Town; giant tortoises and old prison ruins. OSM island node n7108540287. Ferry/boat timing must be confirmed locally.

venues.name: Nakupenda Sandbank
venues.note: Boat trip sandbank off Stone Town. Three OSM nodes agree on this position (n8158499817, n8245114318, n8310729017); a fourth node n7108562685 sits at lng 39.1276 and is rejected as likely misplaced.

venues.name: Kidichi Spice Farm
venues.note: Spice farm tour about 10 km from Stone Town; OSM has several spice farms and Kidichi is the planner pick.

venues.name: Africa House Terrace
venues.note: Hotel terrace bar; OSM tags the hotel (Africa House Hotel). Alcohol served; planner knowledge, owner to verify on site.
